# Animal Facts Encyclopedia

> > A comprehensive online encyclopedia featuring detailed facts, photos, and videos about wild animals, ocean animals, African wildlife, and the distinctions between domestic and wild species.

Animal Facts Encyclopedia provides an extensive directory of over 100 animal species organized alphabetically and by habitat categories. The site covers wildlife from African safaris to ocean mammals including blue whales, dolphins, sea otters, killer whales, manatees, seals, and sea lions, along with educational content on animal behavior and domestication.

## Key Topics

- wild animals
- ocean animals
- African animals
- blue whale
- dolphin
- sea otter
- killer whale
- animal domestication
- wildlife behavior
- animal species classification
- marine mammals
- African Safari wildlife
- captive breeding
- animal habitats

## Main Navigation

- [Animal Facts Encyclopedia](https://www.animalfactsencyclopedia.com/): Homepage for online animal encyclopedia with facts, photos, and videos
- [Animals A to Z](https://www.animalfactsencyclopedia.com/Animals-A-to-Z.html): Alphabetical index of 100+ animal species with facts and photos

## Animal Categories by Habitat

- [Wild Animals](https://www.animalfactsencyclopedia.com/Wild-animals.html): Wild animals category featuring tigers, bears, wolves, and untamed species
- [Ocean Animals](https://www.animalfactsencyclopedia.com/Ocean-animals.html): Ocean animals category with marine mammals like whales, dolphins, and otters
- [African Animals](https://www.animalfactsencyclopedia.com/African-animals.html): African animals category featuring safari wildlife and continent fauna

## Educational Articles

- [What's the Difference Between a Wild Animal and Domestic Animal?](https://www.animalfactsencyclopedia.com/difference-between-wild-animal-and-domestic-animal.html): Article on wild vs domestic animals and untameable species like zebras
